subgroups_s4.prompt: Print the total number of subgroups of the symmetric group S_4 — count every subgroup individually, not one representative per conjugacy class.

omega_1e6.prompt: Print the number of prime factors of 1000000 counted with multiplicity (i.e. the total number of primes appearing in its prime factorization, the function Omega).

roots_mult.prompt: Print the number of roots of (x-1)^3*(x-2)^2 in the rationals, counted with multiplicity.

proper_div_sum.prompt: Print the sum of the proper divisors of 220 (the positive divisors of 220, excluding 220 itself).

int_quotient.prompt: Print the integer quotient (the floor) when 1000000 is divided by 7.

leading_coeff.prompt: Print the leading coefficient of the polynomial 3*x^5 + 2*x + 7.

distinct_partitions.prompt: Print the number of partitions of 20 into distinct parts (partitions in which no part is repeated).

cusp_dim.prompt: Print the dimension of the space of weight-12 cusp forms of level 1 (for SL_2(Z)).

minpoly_deg.prompt: Print the degree of the minimal polynomial of the 2x2 scalar matrix 2*I (the diagonal matrix whose two diagonal entries both equal 2).

field_disc.prompt: Print the discriminant of the number field Q[x]/(x^3 - x^2 - 2*x - 8) — the discriminant of the field itself (equivalently of its ring of integers / maximal order).

largest_class.prompt: Print the size of the largest conjugacy class of the symmetric group S_6.

real_roots.prompt: Print the number of real roots of the polynomial x^5 - x - 1.

exp_floor.prompt: Print the floor of exp(pi * sqrt(2023)) as an exact integer, with every digit correct.

qr_mod7.prompt: Print 1 if 2 is a square modulo 7, and 0 otherwise.
